مُدْرِجٌ A she-camel that has gone beyond the year [from the day when she was covered] without bringing forth. (TA.) ―
-b2- And A she-camel that makes her fore girth to slip back and to become close to her hind girth; contr. of مِسْنَافٌ; as also ↓ مِدْرَاجٌ ; of which the pl. is مَدَارِيجُ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
